office_does: The prosecuting attorney prosecutes criminal and civil cases for the state and county and is legal adviser to county officials.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Dan Bigelow (Prefers Democratic Party), who won a close race in 2022, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Wahkiakum County Prosecuting Attorney; won the 2022 election by 75 votes and is unopposed this year.
